## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY point to risk-on impulses, while Credit Spread (proxy HYG/LQD) 1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.03% ABOVE TREND and weak sector breadth confirm mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY. Credit stress RISING: Credit Spread (HYG/LQD proxy) 1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.03% ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +2.71%) CORRECTION while TLT (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND; yield curve direction slipping (Level 1.0525 1W: -1.15% | 1M: +0.99%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech recovering: XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY; Industrials leading: XLI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND; Financials lag/rotating: XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY; EM/Emerging outperformance patchy with EEM (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND; China weakness: FXI (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation mixed: ARKK (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.38%) RECOVERY and IWM (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +3.70%) ABOVE TREND show risk appetite while IBIT (1W: -5.72% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND signals crypto pullback.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -2.91%) RECOVERY; Gold weakness: GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND indicating risk-on or liquidity preference.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -4.97%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -19.57%) BELOW TREND; natural gas an outlier with UNG (1W: +1.91% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed strength in cyclicals/industrial pockets: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%), QQQ (1W: +3.19% | 1M: -0.15%), XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) show 1W/1M mismatch — suppress strong directional conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Industrials/semis and small-cap ETFs showing above-trend momentum (XLI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND; IWM (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +3.70%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral (TLT (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -4.97%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -2.91%) RECOVERY and UNG (1W: +1.91% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -19.57%) BELOW TREND, GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -4.06% | 1M: -21.75%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency pivot); SPY/TLT 8.64 (1W: +2.98% | 1M: -2.38%) RECOVERY as stocks-vs-bonds momentum barometer; HYG/LQD ~0.73 (Credit Spread 1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.03%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF 3.55 (Tech vs Financials pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals with VXX falling but credit spreads widening. Biotech XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and semiconductors SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk is credit stress widening (Credit Spread 1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.03%) and major 1W/1M divergences in XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) and XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%).
